svg.title: Micah Hoang — Color palette
svg.desc: Primary colors #2C402D, #F7F5F0, #141414. Website neutrals #141414, #525252, #848484. Green tints are derived by mixing forest green with cream.

g.aria-label: GREEN TINTS = FOREST + CREAM. SUPPORTING TINT VALUES ARE DERIVED.
